datasetProvenance.name: TDC hERG

datasetProvenance.reference: Wang, Shuangquan, et al. ADMET evaluation in drug discovery. 16. Predicting hERG blockers by combining multiple pharmacophores and machine learning approaches. Molecular Pharmaceutics 13.8 (2016): 2855-2866.
datasetProvenance.license: TDC toxicity documentation displays both 'Not Specified' and a 'CC BY 4.0' link. Dataset-specific original rights and commercial redistribution were not independently resolved. TDC's MIT software license is not a blanket license for its underlying datasets. Retain source attribution; raw data are excluded from the source repository.

datasetProvenance.name: TDC ClinTox
datasetProvenance.positiveClass: Clinical-trial failure due to toxicity / CT_TOX (1); comparator drug (0). This is not FDA_APPROVED.
datasetProvenance.sourcePopulation: Drugs associated with clinical-trial outcomes; negative labels do not prove absence of every possible clinical toxicity.
datasetProvenance.reference: Gayvert, Kaitlyn M., Neel S. Madhukar, and Olivier Elemento. A data-driven approach to predicting successes and failures of clinical trials. Cell Chemical Biology 23.10 (2016): 1294-1301.

training.splitMethod: Bemis-Murcko scaffold; all acyclic molecules share one group
training.optimizer: AdamW lr3e-4 weightDecay0.01 cosine schedule; clipped gradient1; task-balanced masked BCE with sqrt class weight

applicability.thresholdSource: fixed exploratory similarity cutoff; not fitted as a validated applicability domain

limitations: Single scaffold split; internal test only, no external prospective validation
ClinTox has few positive labels; uncertain performance
Calibration fitted on validation and measured on test, not certified
Similarity is a heuristic, not validated applicability
Source licenses require original-rights review before commercial redistribution
No mechanistic model attribution is provided; rule explanations are separate
Isotope mass is encoded, but six isotope-labelled ClinTox records do not establish radiotoxicity performance; no radiation-specific endpoint
